Anthropic Storyteller

A storytelling scaffold for turning briefs and research into structured scene and narration beats.

Installable integration scaffold

This manifest can be installed, locked, and evaluated today. Execution remains blocked until its reviewed adapter ships, so a scaffold never silently runs incomplete code.

Capabilities

scriptstorytelling

Install

npx lazy plugin install anthropic-storyteller -p <project>
